Subject: Escalation: OMNIDATA — 45% discount request / backloaded ramp (deal OMNI-2026-3YR-PRP)

Vivek / Marissa —

OmniData is asking for a 45% blended discount against a 3-year committed prepay, but with a heavily backloaded ramp (15/30/55). They can prepay Year1 only (small), will accept quarterly true-ups and usage floors, and want US data residency and SOC evidence. ARR profile if fully realized ~ $4.1M run-rate; total committed value ~ $9.2M list.

Attachments: redlined_contract.docx (they already sent procurement_terms.pdf)

Why I’m escalating: 45% would be well outside standard precedent for this cohort. The commercial value is real and omni is strategic in vertical (analytics + regulated financial services partners) — winning this could unlock 2-3 references in our pipeline, but the financial exposure is material given the backloaded spend.

Options I propose for leadership approval:
1) Approve a 38% blended discount conditioned on 60% prepay of Years 1+2 at signature and quarterly true-ups + strict usage floors + audit rights.
2) Approve a 40% blended discount only if customer agrees to 65% up-front prepay and capped credits for underusage.
3) Deny deeper concessions and stick with standard 30% blended, require more even ramp or additional guarantees.

Requesting: quick guidance on which path we take and any add'l conditions legal/finance must require.

Hannah

Subject: RE: Escalation: OMNIDATA — 45% discount request / backloaded ramp (deal OMNI-2026-3YR-PRP)

Hannah — good summary. Do not slow this deal down — Omni is strategic and credible. I will approve up to a 38% blended discount on the committed volume provided ALL of the following are met:
- Customer prepays at least 60% of Years 1+2 at signature (applies to committed list dollars)
- Quarterly true-ups with cash settlement for shortfalls and usage floors defined by SKU
- Finance signs off on payment schedule and a non-refundable initial deposit of 15% of total committed value
- Legal includes an audit clause and a 90-day cure for non-payment before suspension (no unilateral crediting)

If Omni can stretch to 65% prepay, we can consider 40% but would need CFO-level review. Please have legal and finance draft the revised schedule and run impact to ARR.

Vivek
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
